family.description: every metric x level x outcome x coefficient type; Holm across the whole predeclared family

blocked.d3_prefix_alignment: NOT_AVAILABLE: no D3/edge-retention implementation exists in the repository
blocked.af3_vs_orc_same_edges: NOT_AVAILABLE_BY_DESIGN: #134 stores SID-level ORC aggregates only, not its per-edge sampled values
blocked.r20_ndcg20: NOT_EVALUATED: the saved Stage3 artifacts only contain topk [5, 10]

exactness.intra: every eligible induced edge, per group; zero-edge groups are UNDEFINED_NO_EDGES and counted
exactness.gap: every original-graph edge classified once; unlabelled edges counted separately and never cross
exactness.af3: triangle-only convention; edges without triangles are 0

convention.graph: TRAIN-only undirected binary item-item behaviour graph from consecutive history+target pairs (same construction and item mapping as #134); each undirected edge counted once
convention.convention: binary, unweighted, simple graph H; for every undirected edge e=(u,v): F_H(e)=4-deg_H(u)-deg_H(v); T_H(e)=|N_H(u) inter N_H(v)|; AF3_H(e)=F_H(e)+3*T_H(e)
convention.af3_frozen: triangle-only convention; no square/4-cycle terms, no weighted variant, no normalisation, and NOT the hyperbolic sectional curvature -c_l

degree_rule.intra: induced internal degree inside the prefix group
degree_rule.inter: quotient-graph degree (one node per occupied prefix)
degree_rule.gap: original item-graph degree and original item-graph triangles, computed once and never recomputed after group assignment

gap.Gap_AF3(l): mean(AF3_G(e), e in E_in(l)) - mean(AF3_G(e), e in E_cross(l))
gap.unlabelled: edges touching an item without a hard prefix are counted separately and never classified as cross
gap.undefined: UNDEFINED_INSUFFICIENT_WITHIN_EDGES / UNDEFINED_INSUFFICIENT_CROSS_EDGES, never 0 or a surrogate
nulls: global label shuffle (preserves the label-size histogram)
20 deterministic replicates each; z only when sd>0

convention.not_evaluated: R@20/NDCG@20 do not exist in the saved Stage3 artifacts (topk_list=[5,10]); they are NOT_EVALUATED and never synthesised from beam_size=20
convention.orc: no new ORC is computed; the #134 16-edge true-geodesic ORC is compared only on its identical sampled edges and is labelled SAMPLED_ESTIMATE
convention.d3: no D3/prefix-alignment implementation exists in the repository (searched 2026-11-03); reported NOT_AVAILABLE, and hard prefix edge retention E_in/(E_in+E_cross) is used as the explicitly named comparison instead

answers.q2_gap_beyond_retention: YES: the partial Pearson of gap_af3 vs R@10 controlling edge retention is 0.7881027846589761 / 0.7507349376377254 / 0.5860046571439954 at L1/L2/L3 (p = 2e-4); against the ordinary-Forman gap the AF3 increment is 0.31972057716017827 / 0.2560358350721396 / 0.48427760912149515
